description: Replace a gate's whitelist. Replaces the gate's whole whitelist with `entries`, creating the block if the gate didn't have one. Idempotent — the same call twice leaves the same list.

anyOf.description: Which identity attribute the whitelist matches on. `email` compares the caller's `email`; `user_id` compares the caller's `userID`. A whitelist matches on exactly one of the two at a time.

attr.description: Identity attribute to match on. Defaults to the whitelist's current attribute, or `email` when the gate has no whitelist yet.

entries.description: The complete whitelist after the call. Pass `[]` to remove the whitelist from the gate entirely.

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

name: release_flags_whitelist_set
